limitations: Static scene packages are not the set visible at one runtime moment; dynamic load/unload logic needs Blueprint/native runtime tracing.
Mesh/material counts include resolved references/imports, not total triangles or pixels; inherited Blueprint/template meshes and runtime-spawned meshes can be absent.
Foliage/HISM binary instance payloads may remain in Extras; instance counts are not guessed.
Material imports are direct map references; full per-mesh material/texture/shader dependency closure is outside this count.
Component transforms retain exact serialized local values and composed parent-chain values, but socket/template transforms and level-streaming transforms require separate application.

The 11 InstancedStaticMeshComponents found in Park reference paths/walls/stairs. They are not automatically classified as foliage; absence of InstancedFoliageActor does not imply absence of trees, which may be merged/static meshes.
